title.narrative: OHCHR Cambodia 2021-2024 - OHCHR Cambodia 2021-2024 Reg K 22-26

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the UN Office of the High Commissioner of Human Rights (OHCHR) in Cambodia is to strengthen further the capacity of both governmental and non-governmental institutions to promote and protect human rights in Cambodia.
This objective will be achieved through four inter-connected goals:
- Advancing sustainable development through human rights - Strengthening rule of law and accountability for human rights violation - Increasing implementation of the outcomes of the international human rights mechanisms - Enhancing and protecting civic space and people's participation
The UN OHCHR in Cambodia aims at supporting the re-shaping of the pathway to sustainable development by strengthening its capacity for monitoring SDGs risk indicators, human rights mechanisms recommendations and tracking and reporting human rights violations and abuses. The OHCHR want to through its work in Cambodia improve UN´s prevention and early warning system and integrate a prevention agenda in UN´s development framework to improve the respect for human rigths and the achievement of the SDGs for Cambodia. The aim is to make Cambodia more resilient to crisis and make international development efforts more cost-efficient, save lives and safeguard development risks.
The intervention is focusing on the most disadvantaged groups facing high insecurities in their daily lives. These are the informal and migrant workers; indigenous communities and other ethnic minorities; persons with disabilities; LGBTI persons, youth, and elderly persons. Within all population in disadvantage or vulnerable situations referred to above women and girls are particularly marginalized - also evident in the Gender Inequality Index value where Cambodia rank 114 out of 162 countries.
The objective of the program is to strengthen the capacity of duty bearers and to promote and protect the human rights of the right holders - particularly the above identified groups that are most vulnerable and exposed in Cambodia.

Insatsen implementeras av FN´s högkommissionär för mänskliga rättigheter (OHCHR) genom dess landkontor i Kambodja. I partnerskap med OHCHR bidrar Sida till att stärka kapaciteten hos både statliga och icke-statliga aktörer för att främja och skydda mänskliga rättigheter som de uttrycks i internationell rätt och FN´s allmänna deklaration om de mänskliga rättigheterna.

The program is being implemented by the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) through its country office in Cambodia. In partnership with OHCHR, Sida contributes to strengthening the capacity of both state and non-state actors to promote and protect human rights as they are expressed in international law and in the UN Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
